description:
## Goal

Publish one GitHub stack in which PR #110 is the semantic-correctness foundation and PR #118 is the recalculator layer:

```text
main
  -> PR #110 wt/kdt-close
       -> PR #118 fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator
```

The combined result must retain one authority for each semantic question, perform less repeated compiler and validation work, and preserve the exact fifteen-ticket PR #118 order on top of the complete live PR #110 history.

## Current ground truth

- PR #110 is draft, mergeable, green, and based on `main`; its live head is `c2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8`. Lint completed in 39 seconds and test in 17 minutes 18 seconds.
- PR #118 is still the untouched pre-stack draft, mergeable and green against `main`; its live head is `63e55daa5836811bd44ee620247371bbbb1dbb73`. Lint completed in 40 seconds and test in 24 minutes 9 seconds.
- Both PRs currently have zero reviews, issue comments, and inline review comments. Neither is registered as a GitHub stack.
- The exact pre-integration common base is `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`.
- Immutable remote backup tags preserve both original heads: `fz-tfn.30-prestack-pr110-c2c723c63` -> `c2c723c63...` and `fz-tfn.30-prestack-pr118-63e55daa5` -> `63e55daa5...`.
- The accepted v2 replay head is `6bc6c6bc84eb324b4426a394c16f3bec20b5cd0b`, exactly fifteen commits on `c2c723c63...`. Every original/replay author, author date, subject, and position agrees. The replay-layer diff is 77 files, +15,044/-6,759 before the final fz-tfn.30 composition.
- Every replayed commit received a fresh ticket-scoped cold review against its combined parent. The durable old-to-new mapping, approved staged SHA-256 values, focused evidence, backup refs, measurements, DAG decisions, and prescribed stack/cleanup sequence live in `.agent/measurements/fz-tfn.30-stacked-replay.txt`.
- The final fz-tfn.30 composition contains only the durable proof, one authoritative canonical-form documentation update, one TDD-proved collapse of two type-comparison maps into a single operation-tagged typed-outcome map, and any cold-review correction to those integration-owned files. It has not been committed, pushed, or used to mutate a PR or stack.

## Combined model

- World owns authoritative interned semantic facts.
- Each retained root ProductMemo is the sole product authority and stores shared immutable answers.
- One dependency index ignites work from exact fact/product movement; no root, activation, waiter, or inventory scan returns.
- Monotone cycles converge through ordinary per-key reactive formulas, not private cone/fixpoint solvers.
- Types owns one-denotation/one-Ty identity and one operation-tagged memoized comparison authority. Rendered/canonical strings remain display and test output only; raw interner order is not semantic authority.
- CallableResolution is the sole dependency-tracked callable authority. Construction-member selection alone owns semantic seat/drop/member order; perturbation is stress input only.
- Native physical reuse preserves semantic identities and is replaced by stable pre-lowering body/content products in fz-tfn.13.
- An unread covariant occurrence never contributes a partial join as a fact.
- Empty-list bindings use ordinary type algebra; no cleaner or compatibility path returns.
- Equal immutable product reproduction retains the prior canonical allocation as well as its generation.

## Measured reductions

- The combined 00420 probe observed 17,840 formerly-deep ProductValue transfers, 13,581 typed RuntimeDemand reads, and 237 packaged-demand transfers: an exact observed lower bound of 31,658 deep copies, now zero. Its temporary counters/substitution are removed.
- The redundant EmissionReadyExecutable aggregate and 237 rebuilds are deleted.
- The combined native corpus is 510 candidates = 474 resolved + 2 known panics + 34 expected fatal paths, with 472 paired codegen successes. It preserves 5,763 semantic entries while removing 55 physical roots, 146 continuations, 201 bodies, and 47,760 native bytes. MakeClosure remains 118. Deterministic work is 206 passes, 18,569 indexed bodies, 17,769 graph roles, 6,796 graph comparisons, and 6,107 body comparisons; 12,796 -> 12,270 ms is corroborative only.
- Settled/missing product reads perform no dependency-map clone. The standing root scanner, settled-presence mode, scheduler introspection, duplicate output-set reconstruction, and duplicate comparison map are gone.

## Downstream DAG decisions already applied

- `.30 -> fz-kdt.214 -> fz-kdt.213 -> fz-kdt.165`; `.214` owns one exact typed path-aware InputDemand flow relation, `.213` owns one reactive atomic per-function InputDemand fact and absorbs the mutual-cycle returned-axis repair, and `.165` adds `callable_identity` as its fourth dimension while deleting the BodyKeying Boolean.
- fz-kdt.4 remains the distinct reactive per-executable RuntimeDemand ticket. RuntimeDemand and InputDemand share generic fact plumbing only, never a cone/solver/bridge.
- fz-tfn.10 through `.12` delete PullSession mirrors, make NativeProgram the sole persistent root product, move macro roots directly onto RootBackendProduct, delete backend/native fact-map/revision bridges, and reassess nested shared handles after owners disappear.
- `fz-tfn.12 -> fz-tfn.13`; `.13` creates stable typed body/content identities before lowering and deletes fz-kdt.163 post-lowering whole-root dedup/index/compare/remap work once replaced.
- New P2 `fz-tfn.31` owns one immutable fixture observation bundle and pure named ratchets, preserves exact non-vacuity/failure attribution/configuration isolation, and pins duplicate three-fixture compilation from 6 to 3. Edges are `.30 -> .31 -> .24`.
- All unfinished fz-tfn children are blocked by this ticket directly or transitively; `bw ready fz-tfn` is empty during integration.

## Final proof before commit

- Mechanical history/mapping/metadata and remote-backup-ref checks.
- Zero conflict marker, replay scaffold, old scanner, duplicate callable constructor, settled-presence, EmissionReady, display-string semantic comparison, or superseded replay residue in the publishable tree.
- Focused one-map comparison-cache RED/GREEN; type predicate/equivalence/order/canonicalization and cross-process causal/artifact gates.
- Documentation tests, formatting, diff check, all-target/all-feature check, and strict all-target/all-feature clippy using `/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-wt-tfn30-stack-v2/target`.
- The latest replay head already passed full library (1,773 passed/6 ignored), serial fixture matrix (528 passed/3 ignored), all 25 fz2 CLI tests, ignored native census, targeted causal/lifecycle/ownership gates, check, strict clippy, fmt, and diff. Do not rerun broad suites unless the final integration correction invalidates their covered behavior.
- A fresh ticket-scoped cold review approves the exact staged fz-tfn.30 diff before its only commit.

## Publication and acceptance

After cold approval and the single fz-tfn.30 commit:

1. Move only `fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator` to the proven ticket head; leave `wt/kdt-close` at `c2c723c63...`.
2. Initialize `gh stack init --base main wt/kdt-close fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator`, run `gh stack rebase --no-trunk`, then `gh stack submit`.
3. Verify #110 remains draft against `main`; #118 remains draft against `wt/kdt-close`; the remote order is #110 -> #118 and all new CI is green.
4. Replace PR #118's stale body with the combined topology/head, exact 5,763/-55/-146/-201/-47,760/31,658->0 measurements, and fresh check links/durations. Leave #110's body unchanged while its head remains unchanged.
5. Record actual published heads, bases, draft state, stack state, CI links/conclusions/durations, and cleanup in this authoritative description. No second repository commit or fake pre-publication result is required.
6. Only after durable remote stack and CI proof, remove the integration-owned v1/v2 and detached `/private/tmp/fz-tfn30-{kdt45-base-wt,kdt72-base-wt,pr110-base-wt,tfn23-original}` worktrees, their disposable targets (`/tmp/fz-tfn30-stack-v2-target.MkNvfB`, `/tmp/fz-tfn30-stack-target.PoFDXm`, and v1/v2 worktree targets), and outside-repository mapping notes. Preserve unrelated worktrees and user-owned untracked files.

Acceptance requires the exact stack topology, both draft PRs, fresh green CI, the PR #118 body update, all temporary integration state removed, and no unfinished epic child accidentally released before this ticket closes.
